meaning:
Hormah = "devotion"
a town of the Canaanites, conquered by Joshua, allotted to Judah, and located in the south of Judah
Another name of tse.phat (צְפַ֑ת "Zephath" H6857)

renderings.kjv: And to them which were in Hormah

elsewhere.note: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.
The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,
at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
